question: Should OpenClaw accept this signed marketplace feed refresh and persisted trust-state behavior after the predecessor stack is settled, or should the trust-model/config surface be narrowed before merge?
rationale: The remaining blocker is not a mechanical code defect; the PR intentionally changes hosted feed authentication, fail-closed behavior, public config shape, and persisted trust metadata.

options.title: Accept After Stack Rebase
options.body: Settle the predecessor PRs, resolve the dirty merge state, rerun exact-head gates, and accept this signed-feed refresh behavior as designed.

options.title: Narrow The Trust Surface
options.body: Ask for the config, persistence, or fail-closed behavior to be reduced or split before accepting this slice.

options.title: Pause The Trust Series
options.body: Keep the PR open until the broader signed marketplace feed and ClawHub default-feed direction is confirmed or superseded.

recommendation.title: Accept After Stack Rebase
recommendation.body: Settle the predecessor PRs, resolve the dirty merge state, rerun exact-head gates, and accept this signed-feed refresh behavior as designed.

likelyOwner.reason: Patrick-Erichsen is assigned and has been carrying the trust-boundary review for this PR.
